biotools.summary: SGSEA is an R package and Shiny app for survival-based gene set enrichment analysis, offering a user-friendly approach to understanding the relationship between transcriptomic variation and health outcomes like survival.  It extends GSEA by using hazard ratio instead of log fold change, facilitating rapid identification of disease variant pathways.
